-- EFFECT MISMATCH ---------------------------------- main.fango

`traced` performs `Console`, which its annotation does not list.

1| traced : (() ->{e} a) ->{e} a
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

This performs it:

3|     print "start"
       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

The annotation says:

    (() ->{e} a) ->{e} a

but the body needs:

    (() ->{e} a) ->{Console, e} a
